author: York County News
title: Senator Kristin Phillips-Hill provides updates on infrastructure, community events, and legislation
text:
Kristin Phillips-Hill, Pennsylvania State Senator from 28th District | Pennsylvania
Kristin Phillips-Hill, Pennsylvania State Senator from 28th District | Pennsylvania
Senator Kristin Phillips-Hill, a member of the Pennsylvania State Senate, recently shared updates on local infrastructure, community events, and legislative activity through her official Twitter account.
On July 14, 2025, Senator Phillips-Hill posted about an upcoming inspection: "PennDOT announced today that the Plank Road (Route 2074) bridge spanning northbound Interstate 83 just north of Exit 4 (Route 851) in Shrewsbury Township is scheduled to be inspected this Thursday." The Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) routinely inspects bridges to ensure public safety and maintain transportation infrastructure across the state.
Later that day, she highlighted her participation in a local event: "Had a great time at this year’s Snack Town Street Fair! Thanks to all who stopped by our tent. Huge thanks to the Hanover Area Chamber of Commerce for another awesome event. Congrats to Beth H. of Hanover for winning our floral giveaway (no taxpayer funds used)!" The Snack Town Street Fair is an annual community gathering in Hanover, Pennsylvania, organized by the Hanover Area Chamber of Commerce.
On July 16, 2025, Senator Phillips-Hill reported on upcoming legislative business: "The #PASenate Appropriations Committee, chaired by @SenatorMartinPA, will meet to consider 6 bills: SB 460 SB 604 SB 784 SB 877 SB 878 HB 1330" The Appropriations Committee is responsible for reviewing legislation related to state expenditures and fiscal policy before it advances to the full Senate.
Senator Kristin Phillips-Hill represents parts of York County in the Pennsylvania State Senate and regularly communicates with constituents about government actions and local developments through social media platforms.
